images.title: Shapes gain a side
images.purpose: Show that each next shape has one more side: the sequence continues with 6 sides and 7 sides.
images.composition: One row of 5 regular polygons, evenly spaced, side count under each, and a rule line below.
images.exact_structure: One row of 5 regular polygons of similar size: triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon with 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 sides. The first three are teal #0072B2 outline, the last two (the next shapes) amber #E69F00 outline. Side count label under each, one rule label centred below. Exactly 5 shapes.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a shape with the wrong number of sides
images.takeaway: The rule is one more side each time.
images.description: Five regular shapes from a triangle to a heptagon, the last two in amber, each labelled with its side count.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the sides of each shape and say the rule.

image_decisions.why: A single row of shapes with side counts shows the pattern and the next two.
